sourceTitle: iOS 26.6 beta 2 is here, but you won't see much that is new
beta2DateZh: 2026-06-15（Macworld 更新：iOS 26.6 第二个 beta 发布）
beta2DateEn: June 15, 2026 (Macworld update: second iOS 26.6 beta released)
releaseFocusZh: iOS 26.6 / iPadOS 26 / watchOS 26 / macOS 26 等以 bug 修复与安全补丁为主，预计无重大新功能；可能为 WWDC 26 新硬件提供支持
releaseFocusEn: iOS 26.6, iPadOS 26, watchOS 26, macOS 26, etc. focus on bugs and security fixes with no major new features; may add support for new WWDC 26 hardware

features.statusZh: 目前唯一传闻的「新功能」：接近屏蔽来电数量上限时通知用户
features.statusEn: Only rumored new feature so far: warns when approaching the blocked-calls limit

features.statusZh: 若 iPhone 被从手中夺走可自动锁定；可能进入 26.6，但 beta 2 尚未见到
features.statusEn: Auto-lock if iPhone is yanked from your hands; may land in 26.6 but not seen in beta 2 yet

publicBetaStepsZh: 在 Apple Beta 页面点击 Sign Up，用 Apple ID 注册
点击 Enroll your iOS device
打开 设置 → 通用 → 软件更新
在 Beta Updates 中选择 iOS Public Beta（注册后可能需要稍等才会出现）
publicBetaStepsEn: Click Sign Up on the Apple Beta page and register with your Apple ID
Log in to the Beta Software Program
Under Beta Updates, select iOS Public Beta (option may take a moment to appear)
developerBetaStepsZh: 从 App Store 下载 Apple Developer App
使用常用 Apple ID 登录（免费开发者账号即可）
在 设置 → 通用 → 软件更新 → Beta Updates 中选择 Developer Beta
developerBetaStepsEn: Download the Apple Developer app from the App Store
Open the app and tap Account
Sign in with your Apple ID (free developer account works)
In Settings → General → Software Update → Beta Updates, select Developer Beta
